body:
1. In lib/worktrees.mjs createIntegrationWorktree(), resolve base to its commit SHA in repo via git rev-parse before running git checkout --detach in the shared clone so non-HEAD branch names and tags succeed, and call rmSync on path in the catch block before falling back to git worktree add.
2. In scripts/update-adlc-digests.mjs normalizeManifestField(), remove the duplicate ternary inside the object-key loop by delegating recursively to normalizeManifestField(field, val[k]).
3. Move the createIntegrationWorktree commit-SHA test out of test/update-adlc-digests.test.mjs into test/integration-journal.test.mjs, add regression tests covering non-HEAD branch and tag base refs in createIntegrationWorktree, and rebuild dist/agb.mjs.
title: Resolve PR 153 code-review findings on createIntegrationWorktree and update-adlc-digests
